Namespace SharpValhalla.Enums

Classes

LaneDirectionHelper

Helper class for LaneDirection to provide all possible values.

TravelType

An enum that pairs a travel mode with a specific subtype value. Used to represent the concrete travel variant for a TravelMode.

TravelType.Bicycle

Bicycle travel type with a specific bicycle type.

TravelType.Drive

Drive travel type with a specific vehicle type.

TravelType.Pedestrian

Pedestrian travel type with a specific pedestrian type.

TravelType.Transit

Transit travel type with a specific transit type.

Enums

Action

Indicates whether an item should be included or excluded when applying filters or similar operations.

BicycleType

Represents different bicycle types for edges in Valhalla routing.

Each case corresponds to a specific type of bicycle or cycling preference. The raw value matches the exact key string used in Valhalla.

CostingModel

Run-time costing model for route path generation.

Cyclability
DirectionType

Indicates the type of directions or instructions to be returned.

Driveability

Represents the allowed driving directions for an edge in Valhalla routing. Each case corresponds to the permitted direction(s) of travel along an edge.

The raw value matches the exact key string used in Valhalla.

Filter

Represents all available filter keys that can be applied when working with Valhalla routing and map-matching data.

Each case corresponds to a specific field in the Valhalla API, grouped by category (edge, node, admin, matched, etc.). The raw value matches the exact key string expected by Valhalla.

FlowSpeeds

Represents the different flow speed types for edges in Valhalla routing.

Each case corresponds to a specific traffic flow condition. The raw value matches the exact key string used in Valhalla.

Format

Directions response format.

LaneDirection
Language

The language of the narration instructions based on the IETF BCP 47 language tag string. If no language is specified or the specified language is unsupported, United States-based English (en-US) is used.

ManeuverType

Represents different types of navigation maneuvers.

MatchedType

Represents the possible states of a location when aligning a trace to the road network.

NodeType

Represents different types of nodes in Valhalla routing.

Each case corresponds to a specific type of node or intersection. The raw value matches the exact key string used in Valhalla.

PedestrianType

Represents different pedestrian types for edges in Valhalla routing.

Each case corresponds to a specific type of pedestrian or mobility mode. The raw value matches the exact key string used in Valhalla.

PreferredSide

Indicates the preferred side relative to a reference (for example, which side of the road a route or asset prefers).

PriorityType

Priority type for matrix calculations.

RoadClass

Classification of roads by importance or hierarchy used in routing.

SacScale

Represents the SAC (Swiss Alpine Club) scale for hiking difficulty.

Each case corresponds to a specific level of hiking difficulty. The raw value matches the numeric string used in Valhalla.

ShapeFormat

Specifies the optional format for the path shape of each connection. Note: Only if format is set to osrm.

ShapeMatch

It allows some control of the matching algorithm based on the type of input.

SideOfStreet

Alias for Sidewalk to represent the side of street, matching the Swift typealias.

Sidewalk

Represents the presence and location of sidewalks for edges in Valhalla routing.

Each case corresponds to the sidewalk position relative to the edge. The raw value matches the exact key string used in Valhalla.

Surface

Represents the different surface types for edges in Valhalla routing.

Each case corresponds to a specific surface quality or condition. The raw value matches the exact key string used in Valhalla.

TraceType

Each type controls two characteristics: whether or not to allow a u-turn at the location and whether or not to generate guidance/legs at the location.

TransitStopType

Represents the kind of transit stop: a simple stop or a station.

TransitType

Represents different transit types for edges in Valhalla routing.

Each case corresponds to a specific public transit or cable transport type. The raw value matches the exact key string used in Valhalla.

TravelMode

Represents the different travel modes for edges in Valhalla routing.

Each case corresponds to a specific mode of transportation. The raw value matches the exact key string used in Valhalla.

Traversability

Aliases for Driveability to represent the allowed travel directions for different modes of movement. Traversability: Directional access for vehicles along an edge. Cyclability: Directional access for bicycles along an edge. Walkability: Directional access for pedestrians along an edge.

Unit

Distance units for output. Allowable unit types are miles (or mi) and kilometers (or km). If no unit type is specified, the units default to kilometers.

Use

Represents the different use types for edges or paths in Valhalla routing.

Each case corresponds to a specific way or connection type (e.g., road, ramp, ferry). The raw value matches the exact key string used in Valhalla.

VehicleType

Represents the different vehicle types for edges in Valhalla routing.

Each case corresponds to a specific type of motorized vehicle. The raw value matches the exact key string used in Valhalla.
